chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Chapter 449: Lv Xiucai’s Creepy New Power
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang faces a ghost from his past. Bai Lingmiao’s village thrives on debauchery. And Lv Xiucai turns himself into a possessed weapon.
og_description: The banquet’s over. The weeping begins. And someone just turned themselves into a divine murder-machine.
twitter_description: Li Huowang drunkenly collapses into romance, Bai Lingmiao casually authorizes a patricide, and Lv Xiucai becomes a literal flesh-god.

lore_anchors.definition: The silent assistant in a chuma spirit-dance ritual; often possessed or controlled by the Lead Spirit, but here she demonstrates independent will, tears, and sorrow.
A twisted White Lotus expansion of the Buddhist Eight Sufferings, implying a cultivation path that weaponizes a granular spectrum of emotional pain rather than seeking transcendence.
A ritual practitioner who invites a deity to inhabit their body, often through self-mutilation; the body becomes impervious to harm as proof of divine presence.
A pejorative term for erotic or bawdy folk opera; in the Dao-Twisted World, its popularity at “happy funerals” creates a grimly comedic contrast.
A Chinese concept for a death at an advanced age without prolonged suffering; considered a good death, which makes the violent rituals performed beside the coffin all the more unsettling.
A ritual object used in White Lotus sect ceremonies; here it functions as a spirit-summoning conduit during the medium possession.
